items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: You know Red Allen? I don't know his son. No, I don't know his son either.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Kid Allen and Albert Martin, he's there too. You remember that Albedroom? Yeah. And Alex Scott. We had a band there, bass player. We had a band there. That's where, you know, left and went to Mexico, you know. And after that, when we come back, when I got a bass player, he left too. He used to wouldn't go nowhere but right up the country. He's kind of his daddy. Yeah, I remember. Tell me his son is almost as good as him now. Who, Red Allen? Huh? Who, Red Allen? Yeah. You don't know his son, eh? No, I don't…
Red Allen has been to Europe with Dude Ori.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He means George that played with Red Allen, huh? He said, it's George that played with Red Allen.

ctx.x: Ask him George Lewis or George your boy?

Is George Lewis or George your boy? No, not George your boy. I thought the boy was the first one that came from the war. He was the first one that came back there. Ask him George. That's George William, ain't he? Anybody got this band here, ain't he? He means George that played with Red Allen, huh? He said, it's George that played with Red Allen. What did I say? Is he named William, is he last name? Lewis.
Huh? George Lewis. Oh, George Lewis, yeah.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Well, Mary said, you know, when I worked with Red Allen, he had just a rockin' band, you know?

ctx.x: Tell him Lucci used to work with Red Allen.

He said Lucci used to work with Red Allen. Who? Lucci. Lucci? Lucci, Lucci. Lucci. How about Jackson? Well, Mary said, you know, when I worked with Red Allen, he had just a rockin' band, you know? And I told him if he wanted me, I'd pick him up with a band. And he told me, all right. He said, sometimes he was using some of them fellas over the river, like Yank and Harrison. You know, like they wanted to get it, and Bitsa Vai. He said, you and all them fellas, and me and George Louis. So me and George got together…
You were talking about how they used to shoot the light out. Tell us more about that.
